_comment: Review-only data for /review/ (built only when PUBLIC_REVIEW_ROUTES=1). Measurements are filled from qa/heroes-2026-10-10/ results; nothing here is shown on production pages.

measured.conditions: Phone checks at 390 x 844 and 1280 x 800 in Chrome after animations settle (qa/heroes-2026-10-10/first-screen.json). Speed: Lighthouse 12.8.2 mobile (simulated 4G-class network, 4x slower CPU), all pages served from the same local server, 3 interleaved rounds, median shown; a second full pass agreed. Differences under about 150 ms in largest paint flip between passes and are noise; options 2 and 4 were one step (about 150 ms) slower in both passes because they draw the logo larger. Unthrottled, every option painted in 0.15-0.23 s. Accessibility: axe-core WCAG 2.2 AA on each full page, with motion and with reduced motion.

1.Branding fidelity: High: logo whole and prominent on desktop; red/charcoal pipe matches the logo's wrenches
1.Clarity: Clear: the line literally connects a ringing phone to Shane. Small logo on phones (113 px)
1.Phone, first screen: Call ends 650 px, Request 708 px down a 844 px screen; logo drawn 113x111 px (desktop 161x158)
1.Accessibility: axe: 0 serious/critical (moving and still); drawing hidden from screen readers; static with reduced motion; no layout shift
1.Mobile speed (median of 3): score 99, first paint 1.13 s, largest paint 2.10 s (runs 2103-2108 ms), layout shift 0, 369 KB in 9 requests (live home: 350 KB, 8)

2.Branding fidelity: Highest logo presence (largest logo, on white like the van decal); the only dark hero, so it reads as a brand moment
2.Clarity: Clear on phones; the desk phone is a familiar picture. White text on charcoal
2.Phone, first screen: Call ends 648 px, Request 706 px down a 844 px screen; logo drawn 173x171 px (desktop 212x209)
2.Accessibility: axe: 0 serious/critical; white-on-charcoal text 13:1; static with reduced motion; no layout shift
2.Mobile speed (median of 3): score 98, first paint 1.13 s, largest paint 2.25 s (runs 2103-2254 ms), layout shift 0, 378 KB in 9 requests (live home: 350 KB, 8)

3.Branding fidelity: Medium-high: distinctive trade drawing; logo is the destination but small on phones (99 px)
3.Clarity: Most explicit about problems Shane fixes (leak, no hot water, no heat) without new claims
3.Phone, first screen: Call ends 665 px, Request 723 px down a 844 px screen; logo drawn 99x98 px (desktop 165x163)
3.Accessibility: axe: 0 serious/critical; labels in the drawing are decorative (hidden), the same words exist as links below; no layout shift
3.Mobile speed (median of 3): score 99, first paint 1.13 s, largest paint 2.10 s (runs 2103-2178 ms), layout shift 0, 371 KB in 9 requests (live home: 350 KB, 8)

4.Branding fidelity: Highest recognition: reads like Shane's own van (his wording, his decal, his license line). Furnaces left off pending S5
4.Clarity: Headline and actions come first, exactly where they are on the live page; the van panel sits below them
4.Phone, first screen: Call ends 427 px, Request 485 px down a 844 px screen; logo drawn 134x132 px (desktop 206x203)
4.Accessibility: axe: 0 serious/critical; panel hidden from screen readers (the service list is repeated as real links below); no layout shift
4.Mobile speed (median of 3): score 98, first paint 1.14 s, largest paint 2.25 s (runs 2253-2254 ms), layout shift 0, 379 KB in 9 requests (live home: 350 KB, 8)

5.Branding fidelity: Friendly but introduces a new character: proposed brand extension needing Shane's approval; not his likeness
5.Phone, first screen: Call ends 648 px, Request 706 px down a 844 px screen; logo drawn 175x172 px (desktop 217x214)
5.Accessibility: axe: 0 serious/critical; figure hidden from screen readers; no layout shift
5.Mobile speed (median of 3): score 98, first paint 1.13 s, largest paint 2.25 s (runs 2253-2254 ms), layout shift 0, 379 KB in 9 requests (live home: 350 KB, 8)

why: It is the most recognisably Shane's: his own van wording, decal and license line, so a customer who has seen the van in a driveway recognises the site, and nothing in it is new artwork that needs separate approval.

It keeps the headline, Call and Request exactly where they are on the live page (Call ends at 427 px, Request at 485 px on a phone), the best action visibility of the five; the other options push them down 220-240 px (still on the first screen).

Cost: it is one simulation step (about 150 ms) slower to largest paint than options 1 and 3 and adds 29 KB, and it pushes the service list further down the phone page. If speed or a shorter page matters more, option 1 is the runner-up: the lightest option that still tells the "answers the phone" story.
Option 5 should not be chosen without Shane approving a new character for his brand.

options.name: Phone, pipe, logo
options.story: One short ring of a phone, a red line runs through a pipe bend, and the line arrives at Shane's unchanged logo as a panel slides off it. The call reaches the person on the logo.
options.motion: Phone wobbles once (0.5 s), red line draws through the pipe (0.35-1.0 s), cover slides off the logo (0.95-1.35 s). Then still.

options.name: The logo picks up
options.story: A dark charcoal band, with the logo on a white plate like the decal on the white van. Beside it a desk phone's receiver lifts off its cradle once and stays lifted: the call is answered.
options.motion: Two ring marks flash once (0.6 s); the receiver lifts and settles (0.3-0.85 s). Then still.

options.name: Plumbing diagram
options.story: Drawn on grid paper like a riser diagram: a leaking tap, a water heater and a radiator (leak, no hot water, no heat) pipe into one line, through a valve, to Shane's logo. Whatever the problem, it runs to one person.
options.motion: Red flow lines draw from each fixture to the logo (0.1-1.3 s). Then still.

options.name: Van lettering
options.story: Headline first, then a white panel that reads like the side of Shane's van: his italic bullet list, the logo decal and the license line, with a pipe and a wrench along the bottom like the van's rocker panel.
options.motion: The pipe slides in (0.5 s) and the wrench turns once as if tightening (0.25-0.95 s). Then still.
options.caveat: The van also says Furnaces; it is left off until Shane confirms he offers furnace work (owner question S5).

options.name: A plumber answers
options.story: A simple, original drawing of a plumber in a charcoal work shirt and red cap lifts a phone to his ear beside the logo. Friendly and direct.
options.motion: Two ring marks flash once (0.55 s); the arm lifts the phone to the ear (0.35-0.95 s). Then still.
options.caveat: Proposed brand extension, not Shane's likeness. The character is new artwork and needs Shane's approval before any public use; it would also need a decision on whether it appears anywhere else (van, cards, Google profile).
